source: DR 08 T6-3, TY 2026-27 — the same property, self-occupied, new regime
_source: DR 08's W-080 erratum (D-211; D-156 C1(a)): in TY 2026-27 the new regime disallows s.22(1)(b) only (S2 s.202(2)(a)(v)), so the ₹40,000 pre-construction instalment is allowed and the house comes to −₹40,000; the loss "may not be set off against another head (s.202(2)(b)(ii))" and is deemed given full effect to (s.202(3)) — DR 08 T6-3's second line, "SETOFF-NEW-002 … destroyed". T6-1's house and loan, not let; dates as T6-1. INFERENCE, not DR 08's (D-217 C5): the other-sources deposit interest of ₹3,00,000 that absorbs the loss — DR 08 states no income under another head, and any amount of ₹2,00,000 or more gives the same set-off.
